featured_reviews.name: Dev Devoy
featured_reviews.review_text:
During a recent visit to the Smart Bazaar located in Malad West near Inorbit Mall, I had a very disappointing shopping experience. In the dairy section, I noticed a strong foul odor while selecting milk and yogurt. This issue was present across multiple products, suggesting improper storage near expired or decomposing dairy items.
The vegetable section was equally concerning. Several vegetables were rotten and infested with flies and fungus. When I asked the staff whether fresh stock was available, I was informed that there was none.
I also frequently encounter problems with product availability and pricing. Common items such as eggs and soft drinks are often unavailable, and in many cases, price labels are missing. Even when prices are displayed, the amount charged at the billing counter often differs from what is shown on the shelf signage, which is misleading.
The staff appears inadequately trained and largely unhelpful. It is difficult to receive proper assistance when needed. Additionally, many of the high-rated reviews seem questionable and appear to have been posted by store employees.
Based on past experience, I am confident that this review will receive a standard, formal response from the store’s official account, directing me to customer service. Unfortunately, previous attempts to contact customer service have resulted in long hold times and no meaningful resolution. Complaints are acknowledged with apologies and assurances, but the issues are never actually addressed.
If this store were not located so close to my building, I would have stopped shopping here a long time ago.

featured_reviews.name: mohan kamath
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m never going back to a reliance run market..they are particularly useless at running groceries. They’ve cannibalised all the other grocery stories. The experience at the reliance store in Goregaon near Inorbit and the one in Infinity Andheri West were particularly pathetic. The staff is rude, doesn’t know what they are doing and don’t seem to care. No wonder there are no customers. Hopefully the whole thing sinks and these folks get fired. All they do is stare, pass comments and gossip. The payment systems don’t work, the billing staff can’t even communicate in Hindi or English or Marathi ..I guess Reliance goes for Quantity rather than Quality. Their clothing stores were selling cheap stuff and now the grocery markets are horrible. Even Sarkari Bandar and Apna Bazar are better and that’s saying something. The folks at the counter were even unwilling to call the manager or try and help..good riddance. Mumbai North really needs better options like Lulu and Hypercity which were excellent ..plus pls hire staff that can at least do their basic job of serving customers when you are in retail.

featured_reviews.name: Gauravi Thakur Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer at your Reliance store know Fresh Signature . However, due to repeated experiences of rude and unhelpful behavior from the store staff, my family and I had started considering alternative stores.
Yesterday, we decided to give the store another chance, hoping for an improved experience. Unfortunately, the same behavior continued and escalated to an unacceptable level at the billing counter.
While attempting to make an online payment, the transaction failed due to persistent network issues at the store, which have existed since day one. Instead of politely asking whether I needed assistance, the billing staff member took my phone without my permission and began connecting it to the store’s Wi-Fi. This was done without consent or even a basic courtesy of asking first.
This behavior was intrusive and completely inappropriate. Handling a customer’s personal phone without permission is a serious violation of privacy and professionalism. The situation could have been easily handled if the staff member had simply asked whether I required help
